evidence.reason: The denylist workflow invokes gitleaks without `--ignore-gitleaks-allow`. Gitleaks honors inline `gitleaks:allow` comments by default, so PR-controlled file content or commit-message text can suppress a finding. That defeats the required blocking, fail-closed denylist (current contract item 17). The same omission appears on both `gitleaks git` calls and the `gitleaks stdin` call; adding the flag to each scanner invocation via template re-instantiation is the minimal compatible fix.
